patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality product photography and video are used as dominant section backgrounds or hero elements, often with subtle text overlays.
Content sections frequently feature a two-column layout with a large image/video on one side and concise text on the other, or a grid of product features.
Headings use a very light weight sans-serif, creating an elegant and airy feel, contrasted with a slightly bolder weight for body text.
A muted, natural color palette of warm greys, beiges, and browns dominates, with stark black and white used for text and UI elements.
The hero background image blurs and scales slightly as the user scrolls, creating a subtle depth effect before transitioning to the main content.
Sections reveal themselves with a gentle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, maintaining a smooth flow.
The header navigation starts transparent over the hero and becomes opaque white with a subtle shadow after scrolling past the initial hero section.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video or image that subtly blurs and scales as the user scrolls down, creating a soft, immersive transition into the page content.
Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation, where elements gently fade and slide upwards into view as they enter the viewport, ensuring a smooth and engaging content flow.

The primary navigation bar employs a sticky behavior, starting transparent over the hero and then transforming into an opaque white bar with a subtle drop shadow once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, airy, thin-weight headings (~3-4x body) are paired with a clean, legible body text, creating a sophisticated and spacious hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., on buttons, product displays) are used sparingly, maintaining an overall sharp and clean aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and introductory sections, transitioning to a balanced density in product feature grids, emphasizing visual breathing room.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated integration of high-quality, full-bleed product photography and video, often featuring the products seamlessly within elegant home environments. This creates an aspirational, editorial feel that prioritizes visual storytelling and a sense of refined luxury over explicit feature lists.
